document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Long into the hours of darkness, your hapless party struggles 
against the cunning knots of the Keywanema. About midnight, 
as the moon stares down like an eye behind a misty cataract, the 
beasts of the forest draw close. You remind the students that 
wild animal attacks upon humans are rarely reported.
No one will hear of this attack either.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
